whatIs: Watermelon UI is a free, open source collection of React components for Tailwind and shadcn/ui: base components, more than 130 animated ones, landing page blocks, dashboards and templates. You can copy the code or install each piece with the shadcn CLI.
It's a good fit when you want ready-made visual pieces for your React interface, without paying or depending on a restrictive license.
uses: Building an admin dashboard from the ready-made dashboards.
Copying landing page blocks, such as heroes and sections, and adapting them to your brand.
Adding ready-made animations to an existing React interface.
caveats: It's designed for React; in other frameworks you'd have to port the code.
Once the code is copied into your project, the author's updates don't arrive on their own.
With such a large collection, check that the style of the components you mix is consistent.
pricingNote: Free and open source under the MIT license.
idealFor: React developers who want lots of components and blocks at no cost.
